input.title: Amendment to Pyeongtaek V2L Upper Ph3/Lower Building Finishing Work Contract
input.body:
## Amendment to Pyeongtaek V2L Upper Ph3/Lower Building Finishing Work Contract

2022. 12. 21

Samsung C&T has signed an amended contract for Pyeongtaek V2L Upper Ph3/Lower Building Finishing Work with the contract owner, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.

- Contract amount: before change) KRW 897 billion

after change) KRW 959 billion

※ Overview of Project

- Title of Project: Pyeongtaek V2L Upper Ph3/Lower Building Finishing Work

- Contract Amount: KRW 959,486,000,000

- Contract Owner: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd

- Construction Period: January 22, 2021 – March 15, 2023

- The amendment was made for 'Pyeongtaek V2L Upper Ph3/Lower Building Finishing Work' contract with Samsung Electronics concluded on the date of January 22, 2021 (KRW 17 billion, 0.05% of the sales based on the FY 2019 year-end consolidated financial statements).

- The above contract price includes the previous contract amount and the VAT.

- The construction period and contract price, etc. are subject to change in the course of performing the construction work.
